nodes.label: Single Cloudflare Worker deploy target (rationale: fits bootstrap + minimal-budget goal, one deploy pipeline for frontend+API)
nodes.norm_label: single cloudflare worker deploy target (rationale: fits bootstrap + minimal-budget goal, one deploy pipeline for frontend+api)

nodes.label: LiteLLM proxy as sole AI access path (rationale: OpenAI-compatible proxy instead of direct Anthropic API/SDK, keeps model swappable via env config)
nodes.norm_label: litellm proxy as sole ai access path (rationale: openai-compatible proxy instead of direct anthropic api/sdk, keeps model swappable via env config)

nodes.label: stories.json as single source of truth (rationale: only workflows mutate it, only on main, one commit per transition paired with a pipeline-log line, to prevent races and enable crash recovery)
nodes.norm_label: stories.json as single source of truth (rationale: only workflows mutate it, only on main, one commit per transition paired with a pipeline-log line, to prevent races and enable crash recovery)

nodes.label: Steering issue / authorAssociation trust rule (rationale: agents run with write+dispatch tokens, so untrusted text in issues/PR comments could be prompt injection; only OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR comments are binding)
nodes.norm_label: steering issue / authorassociation trust rule (rationale: agents run with write+dispatch tokens, so untrusted text in issues/pr comments could be prompt injection; only owner/member/collaborator comments are binding)

nodes.label: gh pr merge --auto --squash closes the loop (rationale: branch protection permits a merge but never performs one; without auto-merge armed, pr-review's approval satisfies the last check but nothing merges and the pipeline stalls silently)
nodes.norm_label: gh pr merge --auto --squash closes the loop (rationale: branch protection permits a merge but never performs one; without auto-merge armed, pr-review's approval satisfies the last check but nothing merges and the pipeline stalls silently)

nodes.label: 3-round review budget before needs-human escalation (rationale: bounds agent back-and-forth cost; forces genuine disagreements to survive to a human rather than looping forever)
nodes.norm_label: 3-round review budget before needs-human escalation (rationale: bounds agent back-and-forth cost; forces genuine disagreements to survive to a human rather than looping forever)

nodes.label: review-verdict.json verdict handoff (rationale: the review agent is authenticated as PIPELINE_PAT, the same identity that opened the PR, and GitHub rejects self-approval, so a separate workflow step with a different token performs the actual gh pr review)
nodes.norm_label: review-verdict.json verdict handoff (rationale: the review agent is authenticated as pipeline_pat, the same identity that opened the pr, and github rejects self-approval, so a separate workflow step with a different token performs the actual gh pr review)

nodes.label: Demo doc as generated proof-of-work (rationale: a demo doc exists only if its spec passed, so it cannot describe behaviour the app no longer has, unlike a hand-written demo)
nodes.norm_label: demo doc as generated proof-of-work (rationale: a demo doc exists only if its spec passed, so it cannot describe behaviour the app no longer has, unlike a hand-written demo)

nodes.label: pipeline.json stack-agnostic toolchain manifest (rationale: adding a language means editing pipeline.json rather than six workflows)
nodes.norm_label: pipeline.json stack-agnostic toolchain manifest (rationale: adding a language means editing pipeline.json rather than six workflows)

nodes.label: Waitlist approval gate distinct from billing tier (rationale: users.status gates access and is checked on every request except /auth/me and /auth/logout; subscriptions.tier is a separate concern)
nodes.norm_label: waitlist approval gate distinct from billing tier (rationale: users.status gates access and is checked on every request except /auth/me and /auth/logout; subscriptions.tier is a separate concern)

nodes.label: Metered actions: source analysis & feedback pass only (rationale: usage checked against tier_limits before the expensive work and incremented only on success, to prevent AI-cost abuse)
nodes.norm_label: metered actions: source analysis & feedback pass only (rationale: usage checked against tier_limits before the expensive work and incremented only on success, to prevent ai-cost abuse)

nodes.label: RLS as primary authorization enforcement (rationale: anon-key + RLS covers user-initiated CRUD; service-role paths bypass RLS so the API must replicate ownership checks manually)
nodes.norm_label: rls as primary authorization enforcement (rationale: anon-key + rls covers user-initiated crud; service-role paths bypass rls so the api must replicate ownership checks manually)

nodes.label: citation_format immutable after project creation (rationale: keeps in-text citation rendering and the bibliography consistent for the life of the paper)
nodes.norm_label: citation_format immutable after project creation (rationale: keeps in-text citation rendering and the bibliography consistent for the life of the paper)

nodes.label: Deterministic mocking boundary for external services (rationale: nothing in the PR-gating suite calls LiteLLM, Semantic Scholar, CrossRef, Unpaywall, or Stripe webhooks live, so the regression suite stays deterministic; real calls are a separate manual/scheduled eval)
nodes.norm_label: deterministic mocking boundary for external services (rationale: nothing in the pr-gating suite calls litellm, semantic scholar, crossref, unpaywall, or stripe webhooks live, so the regression suite stays deterministic; real calls are a separate manual/scheduled eval)

nodes.label: Additive/backward-compatible schema migrations (rationale: migration and Worker deploy aren't atomic, so a rollback must never land on an incompatible schema)
nodes.norm_label: additive/backward-compatible schema migrations (rationale: migration and worker deploy aren't atomic, so a rollback must never land on an incompatible schema)
